# `useConfetti()`: Init confetti in UI
    
  
```{r example-useConfetti}
useConfetti()
```

  

# `sendConfetti()`: Send confetti 
    

```{r example-sendConfetti}
if (interactive()) {
  library(shiny)
  
  if (shinytest2:::on_ci() && shinytest2:::is_windows()) {
    testthat::skip()
  }
  
  shinyApp(
    ui = fluidRow(
      useConfetti(),
      actionButton(
        inputId = "go",
        label =  "Send confetti"
      )
    ),
    
    server = function(input, output, session) {
      observeEvent(input$go, {
        sendConfetti()
        message("You have sent ", input$sentConfetti, " confetti")
      })
    }
  )
}
```



# `sendFireworks()`: Send fireworks
  
```{r example-sendfireworks}
if (interactive()) {
  library(shiny)

  if (shinytest2:::on_ci() && shinytest2:::is_windows()) {
    testthat::skip()
  }
  
  shinyApp(
    ui = fluidRow(
      useConfetti(),
      actionButton(
        inputId = "go",
        label =  "Send fireworks"
      )
    ),
    
    server = function(input, output, session) {
      observeEvent(input$go, {
        sendfireworks(
          duration = 5,
          colors = list("#DAB436", "#36DA62", "#365CDA")
        )
        message("You have sent ", input$sentFireworks, " fireworks")
        message("You have sent ", input$sentConfetti, " confetti")
      })
    }
  )
}
```
